Title: AI Starter, Sunday Group A
Schedule Details: 3 weekly Sunday night sessions, live on Zoom, Israel time. Sessions 1 and 2 are 90 minutes, Session 3 is a 60-minute live clinic and wrap-up. Max 15 people, with 3-person breakout rooms and a private group chat between sessions. Starts December 2026, exact dates coming soon.
Promise: Go from "where do I even start?" to using AI with confidence for real tasks every week.
Sessions: Session 1 (90 min): Speaking AI's Language Without Overthinking. Session 2 (90 min): Writing in Your Voice and Spotting Mistakes. Session 3 (60 min): Live Clinic, Capstone and Next Steps.
Outcomes: Give AI clear instructions that produce useful results on the first try. Draft emails, summaries and everyday plans in half the time. Know what personal or work information is safe to share and what to keep private. Spot when AI is guessing before relying on its answer. Leave with three saved, reusable prompts you use every week.

Title: AI at Work, Wednesday Group
Schedule Details: 4 weekly Wednesday night sessions of 90 minutes, live on Zoom, Israel time. Max 15 people, with breakout rooms and a private group chat. Starts December 2026, exact dates coming soon.
Promise: Turn hit-and-miss prompting into a personal prompt library and one reliable weekly workflow.
Sessions: Session 1: Building Your Personal Prompt Library. Session 2: Working Safely With PDFs, Spreadsheets and Notes. Session 3: Chaining Steps for Complex Work (outline, critique, final draft). Session 4: Capstone Workflow Build and Demo Day.
